description: Disjoint Set Union unconditionally increments tree rank on unequal unions, violating logarithmic tree depth bounds.
spec_notes: DisjointSetUnion.union must only increment rank[root_x] when rank[root_x] == rank[root_y].

tests.test_dsu.py:
from cluster import ClusterManager


def test_basic_connectivity():
    nodes = ["n1", "n2", "n3", "n4"]
    cm = ClusterManager(nodes)
    assert cm.is_connected("n1", "n2") is False
    cm.connect("n1", "n2")
    assert cm.is_connected("n1", "n2") is True
    assert cm.is_connected("n1", "n3") is False


def test_transitive_connectivity():
    nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
    cm = ClusterManager(nodes)
    cm.connect("a", "b")
    cm.connect("b", "c")
    assert cm.is_connected("a", "c") is True
    assert cm.is_connected("a", "d") is False


def test_rank_growth_bounded():
    nodes = [f"node_{i}" for i in range(8)]
    cm = ClusterManager(nodes)
    cm.connect("node_0", "node_1")
    cm.connect("node_2", "node_3")
    cm.connect("node_4", "node_5")
    cm.connect("node_6", "node_7")
    cm.connect("node_0", "node_2")
    cm.connect("node_4", "node_6")
    cm.connect("node_0", "node_4")
    assert cm.get_max_rank() == 3


def test_unequal_rank_union_does_not_increment_rank():
    cm = ClusterManager(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"])
    cm.connect("a", "b")
    cm.connect("c", "d")
    cm.connect("a", "c")
    cm.connect("a", "e")
    assert cm.get_max_rank() == 2


def test_redundant_connection_returns_false():
    cm = ClusterManager(["x", "y"])
    assert cm.connect("x", "y") is True
    assert cm.connect("x", "y") is False
